changes.historical_text: FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 "Bubonic Vermin" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Era activation semantics: the goat script's target function keeps only Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0, dropping the modern Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,...) check, so the optional FLIP effect can be activated with no second "Bubonic Vermin" in the Deck; the modern script cannot be activated in that state. No dated source for this card, so the chronology is unresolved.

effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 "Bubonic Vermin" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure: on a failed Deck search the goat script calls Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK), revealing and shuffling the Deck to prove no second "Bubonic Vermin" remained; the modern script has no else-branch and reveals nothing. The printed text is untouched by this.

review.notes: Chain starts at lineage v1 (DB1-EN176, Dark Beginning 1, 2004-10-12), which the goat cdb text matches exactly and which is ALSO the current text (modern_text_matches_version index 1, exact) - there is no text erratum after the baseline, so this is a pure ruling record. v0 (PSV-057, 2002-10-20) predates the baseline and differs only in procedure wording ('take ... and Special Summon it on the field', 'The Deck is then shuffled'). Remaining diff items carry no behaviour: CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON+CATEGORY_SET -> CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON is operation-info hinting, and Card.IsCode(id) -> Card.IsCode(MODID) just points the Deck filter at the modern passcode 6104968, which the goat row aliases. Change order: (B) before (A) for the Reinforcement of the Army precedent (allowance gone by 2008-12-15, before (A)'s earliest possible end of 2011-02-02); the true order is unknown. No upstream implementation exists for the intermediate state and it is unreachable while (B) is undated, so no missing-implementation record is attached.
